  Expected change site: the "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph in `.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md`.
  Evidence of absence: A search for "§31 plan" in the s23 reference files returns nothing. Both copies still end the paragraph with "…covers dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." Add the sentence identically to both copies.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Changelog fragment and PR description: the moved text is "copied verbatim" / "word for word", so "no rule was dropped".
  Expected change site: `changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md` line 4, and the PR description.
  Evidence of absence: Once the `send_later` fix and the §23.C sentence land, the reference files will no longer match the original text exactly. Line 4 should say "moved with minimal edits" or similar.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- Requirement: PR description item 1, "That go counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching." The `CLAUDE.md` §23.C paragraph carries "Likewise, the user's go on a §31 plan approves opening the issues (or the orchestrator dispatch) that plan names." (lines 988-990).
  Expected change site: end of the §23.C "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph in `.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md`.
  Evidence of absence: Both s23 reference copies still end with "Do not re-ask; the ask-first rule above covers dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." The reference header claims to be "the full text of CLAUDE.md §23", so the omission makes it disagree with the always-loaded summary. `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` enforces `s21` parity at line 2474, but no test enforces s23 parity for this addition.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Changelog fragment and PR description both claim the moved text was "copied verbatim" / "word for word".
  Expected change site: `changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md` line 4 and the matching PR description sentence.
  Evidence of absence: `changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md:4` still says "Every section number and subsection letter is unchanged (§6), and the moved text is copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped." That is inaccurate once CLAUDE.md §23.C carries a sentence absent from the s23 reference files, and stays inaccurate even if the s23 gap is fixed, because the entry is folded into `CHANGELOG.md` at release.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
